goal: Convert layer-local semantic evidence into a new query-to-graph interface without overfitting to one observed best layer.
procedure: Compile per-relation best and near-best layer evidence from the frozen audit. Use it only as a soft candidate prior. Design a token-level interface where relation type conditions token attention within candidate layers and then conditions mixing across those layers before graph field selection. Leave symmetric/unmapped relations without directional routing. Do not train until the exact map is compiled and inspected.
constraints: audit scores are priors, not truth
decision_criteria: preserve layer-local capability discovered by audit
avoid overfitting layer 12 from a small diagnostic
keep training authorization separate from architecture design
authority: May design and statically validate architecture. May not authorize training, scaling, promotion, or private-identity gradients.
validation: GitHub CI static contract plus exact source-audit hash binding; exact per-relation map still must be compiled from the 575804 JSON before any training decision.
failure_or_lesson: A diagnostic best layer should not automatically become a permanent architecture choice. Preserve uncertainty by turning audit evidence into soft, relation-specific priors and allow future learning to compose across multiple informative layers.
notes: Contrastive seed against the anti-pattern: 'layer 12 scored best overall, therefore hardcode layer 12 everywhere.'
